text:
Sam C.: FYI the docs team is publishing a short deprecation notice: SDK v3 allowed fuzzy arg names and implicit coercion; v4 will validate parameter names strictly and remove a few legacy aliases. Ivy R.: ok, that could break some callers. Do we have a simple rollback recipe? Sam C.: Yes  two quick options: pin to the latest v3 patch or enable the temporary compat shim. docs-bot: Migration guide + shim: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk-migration (checklist, CI lint, shim usage). Marco B.: pin snippets please? Sam C.: sure:
```
# python requirements.txt
redwood-sdk==3.15.1
# node package.json
"@redwood/inference": "3.15.1"
```
Ivy R.: how long is the shim supported? Sam C.: 90 days after v4 GA; playbook has canary schedule. Ivy R.: CI helpers? Sam C.: pre-commit hook and pytest plugin in the guide: `pip install redwood-compat-lint` then `redwood-compat-lint --check src/`. Marco B.: who to ping on rollouts? Sam C.: @sam or #eng-runtime and open an infra issue with `sdk-compat`. TL;DR: pin if you need no-change, otherwise follow the playbook and add the lint to CI.
